## Objective
- Build a complete playable game, then adapt it into a more realistic, full-3D-style jumping spider adventure spanning multiple environments.

## Requirements
- User wants a jumping spider protagonist that starts in a tree and learns jumping, climbing, webbing, attacking, and eating bugs for health or power-ups.
- Progress through the garden, sandbox, lawn, kitchen, bedroom, and bathroom; use stage hazards in boss fights.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.

## Decisions
- Replaced the initial Starwell concept with “Little Legs,” a seven-stage adventure.
- Implemented the visuals as a canvas-based 2D game with layered depth and environmental scenery; it is not a true 3D world.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added game title screen, HUD, responsive styling, keyboard and touch control markup.
- Implemented canvas scenery, spider drawing, bugs, platforms, web projectiles, bosses, hazards, health, scoring, and stage progression in code.

### Active
- Finish and verify the game implementation; confirm gameplay works across all seven stages and responsive touch controls.
- Reconcile the requested “full 3D world” with the current 2D canvas approach or improve the visual depth accordingly.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect `game.js` for syntax/runtime issues and test locally in a browser.
2. Fix gameplay/control bugs and check stage progression and boss/hazard encounters.
3. Capture and inspect a current small JPEG screenshot; improve visuals and mobile layout as needed.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Little Legs game structure, title screen, HUD, controls.
- `style.css`: game styling, responsive and touch-control layouts.
- `game.js`: canvas rendering, game state, input, mechanics, stages, bosses.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; no tests, browser check, or screenshot have been performed.
- Game uses a 960×600 canvas and seven stages; `game.js` is the primary unfinished implementation.

## Objective
- Complete “Little Legs” as a playable jumping-spider adventure across seven varied environments, with improved visual depth.

## Requirements
- Teach jumping, climbing, webbing, attacking, and eating bugs for health or power-ups.
- Progress through the garden, sandbox, lawn, kitchen, bedroom, and bathroom; use stage hazards in boss fights.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Check screenshots using a small JPEG at a viewport no wider than 1280px; read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- The game is a 2D canvas adventure titled “Little Legs,” with seven stages, three boss encounters, and layered scenery.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented game structure, responsive styling, visuals, movement, combat, snacks, health, hazards, bosses, stage progression, pause, sound, and touch controls in `index.html`, `style.css`, and `game.js`.
- Confirmed `node --check game.js` passes; Chromium tests found no JavaScript page errors.
- Verified keyboard movement, snack collection, and mobile layout without horizontal overflow; inspected the latest mobile JPEG.
- Traced the browser 404 to the absent `/favicon.ico`; CSS, JS, fonts, and page load successfully.
- Updated the Kitchen tip in `game.js` to mention hopping over the stove and luring the Roach King toward the fan.

### Active
- Fix and test boss encounters, hazard interactions, and progression through all seven stages.
- Recheck keyboard/touch controls and win/lose states after gameplay fixes.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Fix boss movement/hazard behavior: kitchen fan and bathroom soap do not currently draw bosses close enough to trigger the hazard; boss lure target is clamped to x=1260–1660.
2. Test boss fights for survivability and ensure players can defeat each boss before dying.
3. Test snack requirements, stage transitions, and completion/defeat states; re-run syntax and browser checks.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: gameplay mechanics, stage setup, boss/hazard behavior, and rendering.
- `index.html`: game structure, HUD, title overlay, and touch controls.
- `style.css`: responsive layout and mobile controls.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; earlier `git status --short` showed `game.js`, `index.html`, and `style.css` as untracked.
- Browser tests used `/tmp/opencode/little-legs-mobile.jpg`; viewport was 390px.
- The kitchen boss test showed the spider could die while attacking before defeating the boss; the fan lure test left the boss near x=1510, far from the fan at x=1040.
- The bathroom lure test left the boss near x=1293, far from the soap hazard at x=700.
